{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_real = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Also filter only completed orders, as the question asks for completed orders
df_completed = df_real[df_real['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the mean revenue
print(mean_revenue)"}
